arabic text: AY SHIA BIZAN SAR, BAR SIBTE PAYAMBAR, DAR IN AZAA O MATAAM
english translation text: OH SHIAS! BEAT YOUR HEADS FOR THE GRANDSON OF THE PROPHET (SAW), IN THIS GRIEF AND MOURNING

arabic text: BI NAUHA HUSAINAM, SAR JUDA HUSAINAM, BI AKRUBA HUSAINA
english translation text: IN MOURNING OF OUR HUSSAIN, OUR BEHEADED HUSSAIN, OUR ABANDONED HUSSAIN

arabic text: AY ZAINAB E NASHAD, AY ABID E BIMAR, AY SAKINA E ZAAR
english translation text: O GRIEVING ZAINAB, OH UNWELL WORSHIPPER (IMAM SAJJAD), OH LAMENTABLE SAKINA

arabic text: FATIMA SITAMNAM, AM SINAZANANAN, AMA NAUHA KUNA NAM
english translation text: FATIMA FOR THIS SITUATION, WE'RE ALL BEATING OUR CHESTS, WE'RE ALL RECITING EULOGIES

arabic text: AY BABA ALIYA, AY FATEMA MADAR, AY NANA MUHAMMAD
english translation text: OH WHO’S FATHER IS ALI, HIS MOTHER IS FATIMA, HIS GRANDFATHER IS THE HOLY PROPHET
